overview: White plays 3.Be3 instead of the usual exchange or advance, offering the e4 pawn. After 3...dxe4 White develops with Nc3 and hopes to use the lead in development, although Black can often hold the pawn. It is a rare gambit, not the main line.

white_ideas.idea: Win time with Nc3 and Qd2
Attack on the kingside with Bd3-style ideas

black_ideas.idea: Aim for a solid structure with ...e6

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with White a pawn down

soundness.notes: Strong players don't think the compensation sufficient.

character.reason: A gambit with attacking chances, though Black's Caro structure is solid.

gambit.reason: Black can keep the e4 pawn after ...dxe4.

soundness.reason: White gets little compensation against accurate defence.

structure.reason: Lines open after the pawn is taken.

plans.reason: White hopes to use faster development.
